### One like a Son of Man
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/one-son-man
Passage: Daniel 7:13-28
Points:
- Daniel's apocalyptic vision reveals the ultimate defeat of hostile earthly powers by God's court.
- The figure described as a "son of man" is presented as a singular individual who is unmistakably divine.
- Coming with heavenly clouds signifies deity, showing He is God yet distinct from the Ancient of Days.
- This prophetic vision anticipates the ascension and enthronement of Jesus Christ at the Father's right hand.
- Because Christ has already secured victory over evil, believers take comfort in His eternal rule and protection.

### The Winner - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-winner-one-year-devotions-for-men-july-6.html
Passage: Daniel 7:13-14
Points:
- History proves that even the most formidable human empires eventually collapse into ruins.
- God sits sovereign on His throne, holding supreme authority to judge all earthly regimes.
- The person arriving on the clouds shares both human likeness and divine attributes.
- This vision is fulfilled in the ascended Jesus Christ, who was granted everlasting dominion and honor.
- Believers can find peace during chaotic times knowing Christ's eternal kingdom will never be destroyed.
